_note: Thresholds are judgement calls, not derived values. Do not edit after seeing real results; report any change as a deviation.
_revision_1: Before any trained-policy result existed: G1 Ashman threshold raised from 2 to 3.5. A dry run on an untrained model flagged 100% of states because a 2-means split of a single Gaussian gives D of about 2.66, so the original test could not detect multimodality.

G0_competence.metric: fresh-policy success on clean validation scenes

G1_multimodal.metric: fraction of visited pre-obstacle states with Ashman D>3.5 and minority mass>=0.1

G2_locality.metric: share of squared Jacobian mass within +-3 tokens, averaged over visited states
G2_locality.role: report and interpret; required for trusting shift alignment

G3_mode_gain.metric: keep(shift, rho=.95) minus keep(rho=0) at multimodal states, after real execution of L steps

G4_jitter_gain.metric: relative reduction of overlap RMS at rho=.85 vs rho=0 across visited states

decision: GO if G0 and G1 and G2 pass, and at least one of G3 or G4 passes. FIX-BASE if G0 fails. Otherwise NO-GO for scalar shift carry on this task.
